I've replied to you in this DM, Anselm. I haven't sent anything to Hollis.

Your message doesn't say which rate you mean, so I asked. The only Thornbury Cloth Co. rate I can find is the signed renewal (PEM-ROF-2026-0217-TCC, effective 3/1/26 to 2/28/27): 40 seats at $1,700 per seat per year, $68,000 a year. I found no discount on file.

Two things I need from you:
1. Is the rate you mean the $1,700 per seat, or a different discounted rate?
2. Should it go to Hollis directly, or through Marcus Lindqvist, who owns the Thornbury account?

Hollis is not on the account, and finance figures can only go to you, June, and the account owner, so I'll wait for your confirmation before sending anything.
